notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill provides GitHub Actions workflow templates: Node test matrix with coverage upload, Docker build/push to GHCR, EKS deployment, Python matrix build, reusable workflows, Trivy/Snyk security scanning and an approval-gated production deployment with Slack notification.

Low: the agent writes workflow YAML into the user's repository; the commands inside (npm ci, pip install -r requirements.txt, kubectl apply, docker push) run later in the user's CI, not by the agent, and secrets are referenced only through ${{ secrets.* }}. Third-party actions are pinned to versions (e.g. trivy-action@0.28.0, snyk/actions/node@0.4.0).

Review before adopting: Pattern 3 (SKILL.md:120-157) deploys to the production EKS cluster on every push to main without an environment approval and uses long-lived AWS access keys rather than OIDC role assumption. Related skills (gitlab-ci-patterns, deployment-pipeline-design, secrets-management) are named as optional reading only.
